applicabilityBasis.summary: USDX is described as a 1:1 USD-referencing token backed by Treasuries and cash equivalents with approved-party redemption.

genius.notes: USDX has reserve and redemption disclosures, but no public GENIUS approval, official application, issuer pathway announcement or foreign-issuer exception source was found in the dated review. The issuer disclaimer expressly identifies HTMI Limited and restricts contractual redemption rights to AML/KYC-onboarded parties under separate agreements; ordinary token holding alone gives no contractual claim. The htdigitalassets.com homepage references regular attestation reports but no dedicated disclosure URL or monthly accountant report was publicly linked in the opened material. Reserves are described as Treasuries, cash and cash equivalents; holders do not receive interest on reserves merely by holding USDX, and Clearpool investment-pool yield is a separate product. Hex Trust group offices/licenses, including an Italy office, are not token-specific EU or GENIUS issuer authorization. Exact HTMI incorporation domicile was not established by the reopened issuer material, so the prior group-derived Hong Kong issuerDomicile is omitted without changing issuerEntity.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No reviewed source identifies this token or its established legal issuer as a GENIUS permitted payment stablecoin issuer, state-qualified issuer, official applicant, or federally registered foreign issuer; no token-specific GENIUS pathway announcement or U.S. enforcement action was located. This is a dated, bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no private application or regulatory engagement exists. Non-U.S. licenses, bank or trust charters, reserve assurances and proposed rules do not establish GENIUS authorization.
